mechanism: Both drugs can cause CNS depression and perphenazine may be metabolized by CYP3A4, which dexamethasone induces, potentially reducing perphenazine levels; additionally, both have anticholinergic and neuroleptic effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and excessive CNS depression; consider perphenazine dose adjustment if dexamethasone is initiated or discontinued; watch for anticholinergic side effects.
